events.ui.helpline: Lost money to a scam? Call 1930 or report at cybercrime.gov.in.
events.injury.title: Ouch!
events.injury.story: {{name}} slipped on the wet stairs at home. The ankle is swollen and it hurts to walk.
events.injury.bill: The doctor checks the ankle, wraps it and gives medicine. The bill is ₹600.
events.injury.pay.label: Pay ₹600 now
events.injury.pay.outcome: You paid the bill. The ankle is healing well.
events.injury.pay.lesson: Money kept aside for surprises (an emergency fund) makes a bad day easier.
events.injury.borrow.label: Borrow ₹600 from family
events.injury.borrow.outcome: Family helped with the bill. You now owe ₹600 and need to pay it back.
events.injury.borrow.lesson: A loan from family helps today, but it is still a loan. It has to be paid back.
events.injury.rest.label: Skip the doctor, rest at home
events.injury.rest.outcome: You saved the money, but the ankle still hurts and you worry about it.
events.injury.rest.lesson: Some things cannot wait. Planning for surprises means you never have to choose between money and health.
events.kyc.m1: Dear customer, your bank account will be BLOCKED today.
events.kyc.tap.label: Tap the link and update
events.kyc.tap.outcome: The page asked for your details and a code. Then ₹500 left your account.
events.kyc.ignore.label: Ignore and delete it
events.kyc.ignore.outcome: You deleted the message. Your money is safe.
events.kyc.lesson: Banks never ask you to update KYC (proof of who you are) through a link in a message.
events.tuition.m1: Hi {{name}}! My son has a maths test on Monday.
events.tuition.m2: Can you help him on Saturday for 2 hours? I will pay ₹300.
events.tuition.accept.label: Yes, I can help
events.tuition.accept.reply: Thank you! See you Saturday at 4.
events.tuition.accept.outcome: You taught for 2 hours and earned ₹300. Tiring, but worth it.
events.tuition.decline.label: Sorry, not this week
events.tuition.decline.outcome: You kept your Saturday free to rest.
events.tuition.lesson: Real work pays you after you do it. You never pay to get a real job.
events.lottery.m1: CONGRATS!! Your number won ₹25,000 in our Lucky Draw!
events.lottery.m2: Pay a ₹299 processing fee today to claim your prize.
events.lottery.pay.label: Pay ₹299 to claim it
events.lottery.pay.outcome: No prize ever came. The ₹299 is gone.
events.lottery.block.label: Block the number
events.lottery.block.outcome: You blocked them. You never entered a lucky draw anyway.
events.lottery.lesson: A real prize never asks you to pay first. If you did not enter, you did not win.
events.club.m1: Hello students! The savings club meets at the Bank this week.
events.club.m2: Come and see how money can grow over time, with examples. No money needed.
events.club.visit.label: I will visit the Bank
events.club.visit.reply: Great! Look for the Time Machine there.
events.club.visit.outcome: You plan to visit the Bank on the map to learn more.
events.club.later.label: Maybe later
events.club.later.outcome: You can visit the Bank any time.
events.club.lesson: Real places to learn about saving explain the risks and never rush you or ask for money in a chat.
events.double.m1: Double your money in 7 days! Send ₹1,000, get ₹2,000 back. 100% safe!!
events.double.m2: Only 3 spots left. Send now before it closes!
events.double.send.label: Send ₹1,000
events.double.send.outcome: Seven days passed. The number stopped replying. The ₹1,000 is gone.
events.double.ignore.label: Ignore it
events.double.ignore.outcome: You ignored it. Your money is safe.
events.double.lesson: Money that grows always has risk, and it grows slowly. A promise to double it fast is a trap.
events.shift.m1: {{name}}, the festival rush is on and I need help at the shop.
events.shift.m2: Sunday, 10 to 2. I will pay ₹250. Can you come?
events.shift.accept.label: Yes, I will come
events.shift.accept.outcome: You worked the Sunday rush and earned ₹250.
events.shift.decline.label: Sorry, I cannot
events.shift.lesson: Earning extra means giving time and energy. It is your choice when to say yes.
events.otp.m1: Sorry, I sent ₹500 to your number by mistake!
events.otp.m2: Please share the OTP you just got so I can take it back. Quick please!
events.otp.share.label: Share the OTP
events.otp.share.outcome: The OTP let them into your account. ₹800 was taken.
events.otp.refuse.label: Never share it, block
events.otp.refuse.outcome: You kept the OTP to yourself. Nothing was taken.
events.otp.lesson: An OTP (one-time password) is a key to your account. Never share it with anyone.
scam.why.urgency: Pressure to act right now is a warning sign.
scam.why.link: Unknown links can steal your details.
scam.why.unknown_sender: You do not know this sender. Be careful.
scam.why.asks_otp: No honest person asks for your OTP.
scam.why.too_good: Too good to be true usually is.
scam.why.upfront_fee: Real prizes never ask you to pay first.
